title: All-in-One shared training changes conditional path geometry
supported_claim: Shared training changes conditional restoration-path geometry with phase, seed and domain dependence; a frozen six-domain single-training-seed experiment also shows positive held-out shared-clock regret.
rejected_claim: There is a universal fixed over-compression window shared by all seeds and domains.
limitations: The six-domain expansion uses one new training seed (2051).
Image-level bootstrap does not establish training-seed stability.
Positive shared-clock regret is observational path-geometry mismatch, not causal restoration harm.
No candidate algorithm is validated by this motivation evidence.
